name: What is the typical process for a home remodeling project with a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a home remodeling project with a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your project vision, budget, and timeline. Next, the contractor will develop a detailed proposal, often including design concepts and material selections. Once the proposal is approved, permits are secured, and a construction schedule is established. Construction then commences, with the contractor managing all subcontractors, site logistics, and regular communication with you. The project concludes with a final walkthrough and completion of any punch-list items, ensuring your satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes consultation, proposal, permitting, construction management with regular updates, and a final walkthrough to ensure satisfaction.
